body:
A Foxy Time With 5-MeO-DiPT
A 2 months ago my friend 'K' had gotten about 1/8th of some foxy and I had purchased some remembering the foxy I had tried a couple years ago. I've tried many psychedelics ranging from chems to delirious plants and many substances. Around 10:00PM I receive 5 gel caps filled with 11-15mg each. I call it a night and wait for the morning to start my experience.
9:00AM - Girlfriend 'C' comes over, We eat breakfast to have good energy for the day.
11:00AM - Double check we have everything we need for the day and then I down my first gel cap.
0:30 - Foxy hasn't started to hit yet so I assume that my tolerance has raised for it a bit so I down another capsule, 'C' tells me to be cautious with it and loads us a bowl of some green I got from a close friend.
1:00 - Definitely feel something, feeling a little bit nauseous so I tell myself not to hurl and to hold it all in, so I sit down on a picnic bench in my back yard until my stomach settles, things start getting brighter, the cactus blooms start becoming a more vibrant pink, sand starts becoming what seems reflective.
2:00 - 'C' and I have gone inside and started to play zombies, About half way through I notice an intense 'Rolling' sensation and slowly start coming down it seems like so I down another capsule.
2:30 - I start to have my first peak, I lay down in my bed and start to slowly slip into my head, I try focusing on one thing but can't, my mind is all over the place, a feeling of dropping on a skydiver ride in my stomach is stuck and I feel as if I'm flying for a minute, then when 'C' opens the door I seem to snap back to reality and sober up a bit.
3:00 - it's 2:00 and there's color patterns across my walls, color blots everywhere, I grab my grinder and one of my pipes and go into my grow room, I call 'K' asking if it was safe to take 3 capsules because things start getting a little bit intense, he replies telling me no and to be careful.
4:00 - I start to peak for a 2nd time this time things start swirling and morphing at such a fast pace, I close my eyes and am hit with such a euphoria and such colorful visuals I slip into my thoughts for the next hour sitting and holding my pipe while.
5:00 - I figure its been a while since I've eaten so I grabbed a pack of saltines and chowed down before things would start getting intense again.
For the rest of my trip I spent drawing and colouring pictures of visuals I was seeing until I came down into my crash
[Reported Dose: '33-45mg of foxy, 2gs of cannabis']
